transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we prepare for the final review of the employee share repurchase program, I'd like to hear from each of you — legal, treasury, tax, and human resources — on your applicable operating requirements. Please come prepared to state your specific requirements and name the responsible person for each commitment. The board has approved developing the program, and once I have your operating requirements on the record, I'll incorporate them into the final terms and authorize the program. This review is not a reason to defer — it's the step where we establish and capture the requirements that will govern the program.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During my review of the draft tender documents this week, I confirmed two legal operating requirements that are not yet reflected in the draft: (1) the program must screen participants for material nonpublic information (MNPI) before they can participate, and (2) the program must use an independent tender administrator to oversee the process. These safeguards need to be incorporated into the final program terms.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I received a tax memorandum yesterday confirming two tax operating requirements for the repurchase program: (1) repurchase proceeds must be withheld at exactly 22%, and (2) the withheld amounts must be remitted within three business days. These requirements are not yet in the finance approval packet. The settlement commitment for these tax requirements must be assigned to me, Jonah, as the named responsible person — not to the Tax department or a generic group.
